Stage31 floor substrates are provisional plan reconstructions, not net areas or measured slabs. Common outer envelope and 0.25 m thickness are inferred. Explicit conservative core exclusions preserve circulation voids.
Ständerat low/high finished levels follow 211920 (+5.25/+5.70); intermediate contours and doorway treads remain fitted. Existing underlying wide slab and lower side approaches retained.
Stage36 trims old gallery floors/cornices and subsidiary closures around the archive stair envelope. Guard and pier footprints remain excluded from circulation; no accessibility certification.
Stage37 generic infill split into coordinated zones; missing north-side stair connections are not invented. Heights remain local datums, not a continuous accessible floor.
v027 stage38: Room301 redundant attic plate trimmed, same-height room finishes retained; round-table insert reunited with its physical table. Exact concealed build-up is not established.
